name: Basedash OG social card — dark headline + dashboard mockup by Basedash in Español Français & Português
description: A 1200×630 social card split asymmetrically: a huge three-line white headline with a full stop anchors the left half, while a floating revenue-dashboard mockup card carries the proof on the right. Hierarchy is driven almost entirely by type scale and weight on a near-black ground, with violet and blue reserved exclusively for the chart lines and delta chips. The mockup is the only dense element — rounded corners, hairline border, faint warm wash at the top and two glowing data series — so the card reads as a single statement-plus-artifact composition at thumbnail size.
